verdict.rationale: Workers documents its own Wrangler CLI commands for deploying Workers from a local project, which implies deploying without a Git integration. Nothing in the evidence shows uploading a folder of files directly, or keeping a new deployment private or unpublished until the developer promotes it. Rollback to previous versions is a different capability and is not credited. Missing for 10: explicit direct folder/file upload docs, an explicit no-Git deploy path, a private or preview deployment held until publish, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy a project by uploading a folder of files directly, with no Git repo required and the new deployment kept private until I choose to publish it

citations.quote: The core Wrangler commands for creating, developing, and deploying Workers are on the Workers commands page.
Wrangler offers a number of commands to manage your Cloudflare Workers.
